candidates.name: Ralli Hall
candidates.description: Historic site in Brighton and Hove, United Kingdom
candidates.extract: Ralli Hall (also known as Ralli Memorial Hall) is a community centre, events venue, theatre stage, business hub and main hall in Hove, part of the English coastal city of Brighton and Hove. Built in 1913 as a memorial to Stephen Ralli, a member of a wealthy Greek family who had donated money to many causes throughout Brighton and Hove, it was used for about 60 years as a church hall linked to Hove's parish church.

candidates.name: The Montefiore Hospital, Hove
candidates.extract: The Montefiore Hospital is a private hospital in Hove, part of the English coastal city of Brighton and Hove. It opened in November 2012 and is operated by Spire Healthcare, the second largest provider of private healthcare in the United Kingdom.

candidates.name: Preston Park Velodrome
candidates.extract: The Preston Park Velodrome is an outdoor velodrome in the north-east corner of Preston Park in Brighton, United Kingdom. It is the oldest velodrome in the United Kingdom having been opened on 30 May 1887.
